recommendations.title: Dominant marketplace cost
recommendations.shortDescription: Logistics is the largest cost line at 52.0% of Revenue.
recommendations.businessExplanation: When a single marketplace cost exceeds a quarter of Revenue, it is the primary lever for margin recovery — not a secondary optimization.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Review warehouse allocation and shipping profile to reduce logistics pressure.

recommendations.title: Logistics cost pressure
recommendations.businessExplanation: Elevated logistics share compresses Net Margin regardless of top-line growth. Warehouse mix and return logistics are typical drivers.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Review warehouse allocation and return flows; align stock to warehouses that already sell efficiently.

recommendations.title: Product has elevated return rate
recommendations.businessExplanation: High return SKUs inflate logistics and cancel the benefit of unit velocity.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Review sizing, product quality, or listing content for this SKU before restocking.

recommendations.title: Net Margin is negative
recommendations.shortDescription: Every ruble of Revenue currently destroys margin.
recommendations.businessExplanation: Negative Net Margin confirms unit economics are underwater for the selected scope — growth would amplify losses.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Freeze growth experiments; fix fee, logistics, and pricing on the worst margin categories first.

recommendations.title: Net Profit is negative
recommendations.shortDescription: The selected period is loss-making after marketplace costs.
recommendations.businessExplanation: Net Profit below zero means Commercial Performance does not cover product cost, marketplace fees, logistics, and estimated tax for this Report Scope.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Prioritize the largest marketplace cost line and loss-making SKUs before increasing ad spend or expanding assortment.

recommendations.title: Category has highest return rate
recommendations.businessExplanation: Elevated category returns destroy logistics efficiency and Net Margin even when Revenue looks healthy.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Review sizing, product quality, or listing accuracy for this category before restocking.

recommendations.title: Loss-making product
recommendations.shortDescription: ZARAMOR has the lowest Net Profit (-83).
recommendations.businessExplanation: Negative Net Profit SKUs consume logistics and fee capacity without returning owner cash.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Raise price, cut spend, or exit this SKU — do not restock on autopilot.

recommendations.title: Revenue without profit
recommendations.shortDescription: Top-line activity is not converting into Net Profit.
recommendations.businessExplanation: Revenue is present while Net Profit is zero or negative. Scaling this Revenue profile increases marketplace volume without owner cash.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Do not increase ads until the largest cost line and loss-making products are addressed.

recommendations.title: Low-contribution warehouse
recommendations.shortDescription: СПБ Шушары contributes only 1.1% of warehouse Revenue.
recommendations.businessExplanation: Warehouses with very small sales share may be holding inventory that would sell faster elsewhere.
recommendations.recommendedAction: Evaluate inventory distribution — move or stop replenishing stock that does not sell here.
